sloka: सर्वम् मे शंस भगवन् कस्य आश्रम पदम् तु इदम् ।संप्राप्ताः यत्र ते पापाः ब्रह्मघ्नाः दुष्ट चारिणः ॥१-२८-२०॥
transliteration: sarvam me śaṁsa bhagavan kasya āśrama padam tu idam ।saṁprāptāḥ yatra te pāpāḥ brahmaghnāḥ duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ ॥1-28-20॥

translations.english: O great ascetic, O venerable brahmana, from where do those slayers of brahmanas, doers of cruel acts, wickedminded and sinful persons come from and cause obstacles to your sacrifice? Where is that sacrificial place required to be protected by me? Where are these rakshasas required to be slain? O best of ascetics, I would like to hear from you". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
